character_behavior.note: Normal active interaction. Full character materialization rules only when representation changes.

npc_development.note: Load person + current training/health/experience; career domain only if career transition is causal.

character_behavior_profile.note: Only when exact owner lacks sufficient inline behavior and sustained/personality-sensitive interaction is causal. Known owner_id -> direct profile path from index; never load all profiles.

latent_identity_catalog.note: Source-canon name lookup only. An entry does not assert a current body, office, location, capability or clock; prove current existence before materialization.
